name: 58854 · Watford City, ND
findings: ZIP 58854 (Watford City) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 58854 (Watford City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 58854 (Watford City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
